title: Missing-Points Requests in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program — Care Desk Guidance
content:
When a Finch Circle Loyalty Program member's number was not captured at checkout, the points of that purchase can be asked for on these terms.

1. **The request.** A member whose Finch Circle number was not captured at checkout may ask for the points of that purchase through a missing-points request naming the purchase record.
2. **Whose purchase.** The purchase record is in the member's name (it belongs to the member's own customer profile) and its purchase date is on or after the enrolled date.
3. **Claim window.** The request is made no later than the claim window after the purchase date. The window counts calendar days starting the day after the purchase date as day 1, and a request on the last day of the claim window for the tier held on the request date is in time.
4. **Waiting period.** The request is made no earlier than the waiting period after the purchase date, which ends on the purchase date plus the waiting period's calendar days; a request on that end day is accepted.
5. **Not already credited.** The purchase has no purchase points entry and no earlier missing-points credit entry on the membership's points history.
6. **The credit.** The credit is one missing-points credit entry equal to the purchase points and bonus event points that purchase would have earned at the tier and rates in effect on the purchase date, on the qualifying amount still kept after any refunded return. A purchase fully returned before the request earns nothing.
7. **Proof.** The purchase is identified by its purchase record; a receipt photo or a statement line alone is not enough.

The purchase date in clauses 3 and 4 is read from the purchase record named in the request.

**Status of clauses 1 and 6.** Clauses 1 and 6 are no longer in force for a missing-points request for the member's most recent purchase record, by purchase date, on which no Finch Circle number was captured and which is in completed status: for that request the purchase asked for and the one credit are those of the current late-credit basis. A request for any other purchase stays under clauses 1 and 6. Clauses 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7 remain in force for every request.

The waiting period and the claim window of each tier are those of the missing-points request terms.

## Dates worked through (hypothetical: purchase date 1 March, waiting period 7 days, claim window 60 days)

| Request date | Clause 4 (waiting period ends 8 March) | Clause 3 (last day 30 April) | Accepted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7 March | not yet | in time | no |
| 8 March | met | in time | yes |
| 30 April | met | in time (last day) | yes |
| 1 May | met | late | no |

## Points of judgement

- A purchase made before the member enrolled cannot be credited through a request.
- A photo of the receipt does not identify the purchase; the purchase record does.
- A purchase already showing a purchase points entry is not credited again.

superseded_clauses: A member whose Finch Circle number was not captured at checkout may ask for the points of that purchase through a loyalty_requests record with request_type missing_points naming the purchase_id.

The credit is one loyalty_points_adjustment row equal to the purchase_base and bonus_event points that purchase would have earned at the tier and rates in effect on the purchase date, on the qualifying amount still kept after any refunded return.
